data.description: From KYS judge-path QA, local run 2026-08-11. After entering a demo persona there is no visible indication of who you are (the account menu route responds 'not installed') and no sign-out anywhere in the admin shell; the speaker portal has one, the organizer side does not. The server-side half of this trap is already dead (PR #7 replaces the session cleanly on re-auth, verified locally: speaker → organizer switch works on one cookie). What remains is orientation: a judge flipping between personas cannot tell which hat they wear or take it off. Suggest: current persona name + role in the shell header, and a sign-out entry next to it. Value: this is the first thing a rubric evaluator does when exploring both demos back to back.
data.title: Admin shell shows no identity and has no sign-out

data.body:
Closing as already fixed on github/main@16c9f82c. The admin shell now reads its identity from /api/v1/auth/me and renders it: Topbar shows name and role in a reserved slot (src/ui/shell/Topbar.tsx:66), and the account menu carries a real Sign out (src/ui/shell/identity.tsx AccountMenu). A regression test named for this finding ships beside it — tests/unit/shell-identity.KYS-2.test.ts, with the behavioural half in tests/integration/auth-demo.test.ts.

Sign-out has been a one-way door until now: it lands on / and, off a demo instance, there is nothing there to sign back in with. MRQ-133 is building that door.
